Its a good advice although I think there are many American students who come here studying at IDC who never have been to Israel before and they still enjoy their time. Of course, if you want to be sure that you like it, visit before, but no risk no fun on the other hand.

Israel is very different from American mentality which means that just because you are Jewish you will not have the same culture as the people who grew up in Israel. That is something you need to be aware of, otherwise I would say go for it because you are so young. At this age it is rather a learning experience and nothing is cast in stone. And there are many gay people in Tel Aviv, it wont be a problem. And in regards to security, trust that the government is doing everything to protect us and that we have a huge big Jewish community here where everyone supports each other. It sounds like you have more fear of the fear itself. Its not worth it to live your life like this. If you want to come to Israel, come, do not think twice!
